Yes, HCA Healthcare, Inc. announced a change in its dividend policy in the annual report. Specifically, during 2022, the Board of Directors declared four quarterly dividends of $0.56 per share, totaling $2.24 per share for the year. Then, on January 26, 2023, the Board declared a quarterly dividend of $0.60 per share payable on March 31, 2023. The report notes that future dividend declarations and amounts are subject to the Board's determination based on capital availability and other factors, indicating an increase in the quarterly dividend from $0.56 to $0.60 per share starting in 2023 [S1, S2, S3, S4].
